judgments.reason: The bigP3BCI PhysioNet paper covers the whole multi-study P300 collection; nm000200 is only Study I (13 subjects), a derivative subset, so it is not this dataset's own data paper.
judgments.paper_title: bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset

judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiology data into BIDS; it is used for the dataset's formatting, not a paper describing the BigP3BCI data.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: EEG-BIDS is a data-organization standard/specification used for formatting this dataset, not a paper describing the BigP3BCI Study I data.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
